memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: independent in ADLs, walks to market, manages florist shop. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative). falls: none in last 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 10 seconds. medicines: 9 regular (metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD, aspirin 75 mg OD, atorvastatin 40 mg HS, metoprolol 25 mg OD, isosorbide mononitrate 20 mg OD, GTN SOS) – polypharmacy, review against Beers. mood: calm. carers: daughter Priya, relationship: daughter. goals: "I want to keep gardening and stay independent."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.8% (target <7). Fasting plasma glucose 154 mg/dL (70-110). Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 30 mg/g (<30 normal). Lipid profile: LDL 110 mg/dL (<100 optimal), HDL 45 mg/dL (>40), triglycerides 180 mg/dL (<150).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: 12‑lead ECG: sinus rhythm 78 bpm, no ST‑T changes, no Q waves, normal axis. No acute ischemia.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADL independent, occasional fatigue after long walks. cognition: Mini‑Cog not repeated (annual due Apr 2026). falls: none, gait slightly slow, timed up‑and‑go 11 seconds – raised fall risk, advise strength training and supportive footwear. medicines: 9 regular – polypharmacy, medication review pending. mood: mild anxiety, denies depression. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I want to walk to market without fatigue."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: empagliflozin 25 mg OD (increase from 10 mg OD). All other medicines unchanged.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.2% (down). Fasting glucose 130 mg/dL. Urine ACR 28 mg/g. LDL 95 mg/dL, HDL 48 mg/dL, triglycerides 160 mg/dL.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Exercise treadmill test (Bruce protocol): achieved 85% age‑predicted maximal HR, no chest pain, no ECG ST‑depression, BP response normal. Test negative for inducible ischemia.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: manages shop, occasional knee discomfort. cognition: Mini‑Cog unchanged. falls: one slip at bathroom, no injury, gait cautious, timed up‑and‑go 13 seconds – raised risk, refer to physio. medicines: 9 regular – polypharmacy. mood: reports low mood, anhedonia 2/weeks. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I want to attend my granddaughter's wedding in March."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: glimepiride 2 mg OD (increase from 1 mg OD). All other medicines unchanged.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 6.8% (improved). Fasting glucose 118 mg/dL. Urine ACR 22 mg/g. LDL 88 mg/dL, HDL 50 mg/dL, triglycerides 140 mg/dL.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Transthoracic echocardiogram: LVEF 55% (normal). Mild aortic sclerosis, no significant stenosis. No regional wall motion abnormality, no pericardial effusion.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADL independent, shop work tolerated. cognition: Mini‑Cog 3/5 (negative). falls: none in last 6 months, gait normal, timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds. medicines: 9 regular – polypharmacy, medication review due. mood: improved, denies depressive symptoms. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I want to continue flowering shop and travel."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 6.5% (at target). Fasting glucose 110 mg/dL. Urine ACR 20 mg/g. LDL 80 mg/dL, HDL 52 mg/dL, triglycerides 130 mg/dL.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dilated fundus exam: mild non‑proliferative diabetic retinopathy, microaneurysms temporal to fovea, no macular edema, no proliferative changes. Recommend annual review.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: active, tends florist shop, walks daily. cognition: Mini‑Cog stable. falls: none, gait good, timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds. medicines: 8 regular (glimepiride stopped) – polypharmacy continues. mood: euthyroid, positive affect. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I want to walk the Lalbagh gardens without breathlessness."
